units.source_en:
The Spirits originate in the mind’s capacities for wonder (99–101), thought (102–4), love (105–
7), wisdom (108–10), art (111–13), and scientific knowledge (114–16).

Individual minds will effectively be able to prolong the period of their existence through the
‘slowing’ of time by a more concentrated exercise of consciousness; see S.’s note to Q Mab viii 203–7.

paragraphs.source_en:
Chorus of Spirits and Hours
Then weave the web of the mystic measure;
130 From the depths of the sky and the ends of the earth,
Come, swift Spirits of might and of pleasure,
Fill the dance and the music of mirth,
As the waves of a thousand streams rush by
To an ocean of splendour and harmony!
